scope: Theorem 5.5 (Opposite grid answers) of the manuscript “Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting” (preprints/Witnessed-symmetric-choice-is-strictly-stronger-than-choiceless-polynomial-time-with-counting-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 243 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d648a0d83b5f41b1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every L ≥ 2, the fixed sentence Φ of Section 4 evaluates to true on Ab0 and to false on Ab1 . For either structure, every parameter α ∈ P and every terminal selection gives the stated output value, and no evaluation produces †.
